Gigi Hadid

Download PDF
  • 73.5M

Height 5'11'' // 180 CM

Shoe 6

New York +
Portfolio

Gigi Hadid is one of the most iconic, versatile supermodels of our time, having built her career from age 16––and appearing in a campaign at just two years old. Since her NYFW debut in 2014, Hadid has amassed more than 35 Vogue covers worldwide, won the “Model of the Year: Women” award at the Models.com Industry Awards, earned the British Fashion Awards “International Model of the Year,” Variety’s “Power of Women” award, and Glamour’s “Woman of the Year.” She has walked in four Victoria’s Secret Fashion Shows and has worked with brands including Maybelline, Rabanne, Miu Miu, Isabel Marant, Zara, Jacquemus, and more. Alongside modeling, Hadid has designed several capsule fashion collections with other brands. Hadid has also taken up photography, shooting campaigns, and editorials for Versace, Miu Miu, Weekend Max Mara, V, and i-D. Additionally, Hadid has been honored for her non-profit work with Pencils of Promise and UNICEF.
